_meta.name: pea_synthetic_v1
_meta.provenance: Hand-written mock hospital bills (plain text, as OCR would hand it to the extractor). All names, amounts and hospitals are invented. Gold lists were written by hand BEFORE running the extractor.
_meta.description: Each row: bill text + gold procedures (non-medicine charge lines) and gold medicines. A predicted line is correct only if both name and amount match (name compared case-insensitively, whitespace-collapsed). Totals/tax/identity lines are not gold items.
